findings.summary: There is no loading state: while query.isLoading is true the metric cards render 0 and the list section is empty with no skeleton or spinner, unlike sibling pages that show pulse skeletons or loading text.
findings.fix: Add a loading branch before the list, e.g. `{query.isLoading ? <section className="space-y-3" aria-label="جارٍ تحميل الإجراءات">{[1,2,3].map((i) => <div key={i} className="card h-28 animate-pulse bg-[var(--surface-muted)]" />)}</section> : null}` matching the pattern in LiveLocationPage/ServiceDeskPage.

findings.summary: The 'فتح الإجراء' Link uses a bespoke `bg-brand ... text-white` class stack instead of the shared .btn-primary primitive, diverging from button styling elsewhere (hover/active/focus states, radius).
findings.fix: Replace the inline className with `className="btn-primary shrink-0"` so the CTA inherits the design-system button tokens and interaction states.

findings.summary: The due-date deadline text uses a hardcoded Tailwind color `text-amber-600` instead of the warning design token, so it will not adapt to the dark theme or match .status-warning/priority-icon which use var(--warning).
The item.status is rendered as raw plain text in a `.muted text-xs` span while kind and priority use StatusBadge, giving inconsistent status treatment within the same badge row.
findings.fix: Render status with the shared primitive too: `<StatusBadge value={item.status} />` for visual and color consistency with kind/priority.

findings.summary: The error condition reuses EmptyState (a neutral empty treatment) with no error styling or icon, so a load failure is visually indistinguishable from a benign 'no items' state.
findings.fix: Give the error case a distinct error banner (danger token surface, e.g. a `.card` with `border-[var(--danger)]`/`text-[var(--danger)]` and an AlertCircle icon) rather than the neutral EmptyState used for the no-items case.

findings.summary: PageHeader is used without the `eyebrow` prop that other top-level feature pages provide, making the header slightly inconsistent with the established page-header pattern.
findings.fix: Add an eyebrow, e.g. `eyebrow="مركز الإجراءات"` (or the relevant module label) to PageHeader for consistency with sibling pages.

findings.summary: The 'مكتمل اليوم' MetricCard is hardcoded to value={0}, so it is a permanently static placeholder metric that never reflects real data.
findings.fix: Either wire it to a real count from the query data, or remove the card until the metric is available, to avoid a misleading always-zero tile (polish/consistency only, no new data flow required if removed).
